name: getwordcraft
description: Free, fast word-game utilities and references: word finding, anagram solving, Wordle assistance, and crossword solving over an open 437,673-word dictionary.

tools.name: word_finder
tools.description: Find tournament-valid English words from a rack of letters with wildcard (?) support and pattern matching constraints.

letters.description: Letters available on the rack. Use ? for blank wildcard tiles.

pattern.description: Optional board pattern with dots for unknown squares (e.g. 'c..ft').

tools.name: word_unscrambler
tools.description: Unscramble any jumbled rack of letters into all playable words sorted by length or classic Scrabble score.

letters.description: The jumbled rack of letters to unscramble. Supports ? for wildcards.

tools.name: anagram_solver
tools.description: Find all exact full-length anagram permutations for a given word or letter combination.

word.description: Word or letter set to find anagrams for.

tools.name: wordle_helper
tools.description: Filter 5-letter English words matching Wordle color feedback (green, yellow, gray).

green.description: 5-letter string with known letters in exact positions (e.g. 's...e').

yellow.description: Letters known to be in the word but in the wrong position.

gray.description: Letters confirmed not present in the word.

tools.name: crossword_finder
tools.description: Find words matching a crossword pattern where missing letters are represented by dots (e.g. 'c..ft').

pattern.description: Crossword pattern with dots for blank squares (e.g. 'c..ft').
